title: I've been working on my in-browser MOBA for nearly a year and I couldn't be more excited about it. It's starting to feel fun, especially when playing with friends. I would be honored if anyone decides to take a look!
author: ADIRTYHOBO59
selftext:
The map featured is called Jagged Garden. It's a spiritual successor to Twisted Treeline which I played countless hours on as a teenager with my brother.

Here is a link if anyone would like to take a look. I have a lot of unique ideas for the future of the game that would strongly differentiate it from any MOBA I've played before. I cannot wait to bring them to a reality.

[https://www.mercenariesoftezigdal.com/](https://www.mercenariesoftezigdal.com/)

comments.author: MejorSaludMental
comments.body: I feel like the ping will be terrible

replies.author: ADIRTYHOBO59
replies.body: Worth a shot! I get around 30 ping while playing. Depends on where you live of course. If the game does eventually start to sustain a player base I will spin up more servers across the globe.

comments.author: RUSuper
comments.body: Even before I read the text I recognized Twisted Treeline hah, nice job. Gonna be old or newer treeline? With a spider at the top?

replies.author: ADIRTYHOBO59
replies.body: Newer! Thinking about a large serpent for this map actually

comments.author: Alarmed2814
comments.body: Copy of mobile legends bang bang, way way too similar.

replies.author: ADIRTYHOBO59
replies.body: With Jagged Garden I'm trying to get a baseline. Need it to just feel fun and familiar. With Pilfered Plains, that is where I intend to majorly differentiate it from any other MOBA that's out there. Really excited to get to that point.

comments.author: excellentforcongress
comments.body: the lanes look too narrow, with too narrow of a lane, no room for strategic positioning, since the entire map is a chokepoint

replies.author: ADIRTYHOBO59
replies.body: I appreciate the feedback! I'll keep that in mind and may end up opening the lanes up further
